units: metres in Blender, FBX unit scale to centimetres; Z up, front -Y, pivot = footprint centre at ground

texture_channels.N: tangent normal, OpenGL (+Y): flip green on UE import
texture_channels.ORM: R ambient occlusion, G roughness, B metallic (0)
texture_channels.M: R night emissive (doorways, smoke holes, vents), G culture-colour paint mask, B moss/grime mask, A always-on fire (embers)

material_parameters.CultureColor: per instance (custom data), multiplies albedo where M.G
